content:
oncall-zoe: Alert: reranker service eu-central spikes 5xx (~6%). Root cause narrowed to tokenizer shard off-by-one in v3.0.1. Quick patch built as v3.0.2-hotfix. Request expedited deploy for eu-central only, skip 10m canary.

deploy-bot: HOTFIX REQUEST service=reranker region=eu-central image=reranker:v3.0.2-hotfix trigger=alert-rerank-5xx

miguel: Can you confirm no schema or config changes?

oncall-zoe: No schema change, pure code fix in tokenizer. Unit + small integ tests pass. Image pushed.

security-maya: Image scan clear. No new IAM scopes. +1 security.

loren: SRE ok to expedite if we have rollback gates: sustained 5xx >1% for 3m OR p99 latency +400ms for 5m OR logs show "tokenizer-shard-error". Add auto cutback if pod restarts >2 in 2m. Also require post-deploy smoke `./smoke/reranker_check`.

pm-claire: Product ok, will draft one-line release note for status page.

eng-lead-janet: I approve skip-canary for eu-central only with the above conditions.

oncall-zoe: Notifying #support now.

deploy-bot: APPROVALS RECEIVED (4). Executing deploy: skip_canary=true region=eu-central rollout=immediate

deploy-bot: step 1 drain -> OK
deploy-bot: step 2 apply image -> OK
deploy-bot: step 3 run smoke `./smoke/reranker_check --region eu-central`

oncall-zoe: smoke x10 queries PASS, no 5xx. Logs show tokenizer fix applied.

deploy-bot: step 4 finalize -> 100% traffic. Telemetry: 5xx back to baseline, p99 latency stable.

oncall-zoe: Support notified, status updated (INC-7992). Scheduling +15m follow-up verification.

loren: leaving a follow-up to run full regression suite in staging and validate cross-region ripple.

eng-lead-janet: Incident mitigated. RJ: prepare RCA after metrics stabilize.

deploy-bot: AUTO: rollback command `/deploy rollback reranker eu-central reranker:v3.0.1` if needed.

miguel: great work. :rocket:
